relevance_rank_note: Only indirectly tests H2: APOE4 vs APOE3 contrasts are steady-state membrane/total ABCA1 in aged TR mouse cortex and postmortem human brain; lysosomal ABCA1 data are AD-vs-NCI or drug-vs-vehicle in APOE4 only; no recycling assay, no ARF6 manipulation.

description: Cortex of 22-month-old APOE-TR mice was fractionated; in the TBSX membrane-enriched fraction ABCA1 was lower and caveolin-1 higher in APOE4-TR than APOE3-TR, while the GnHCl aggregated fraction showed no genotype difference in either.
quote: in cortices from 22-month-old APOE3-TR and APOE4-TR mice, caveolin-1 protein levels in the membrane protein-enriched fraction were significantly higher in APOE4-TR mice than in APOE3-TR mice, while membrane ABCA1 levels were lower in APOE4-TR mice (Fig. 3K)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less membrane-fraction ABCA1, more membrane caveolin-1)
system: Human APOE3- vs APOE4-targeted-replacement mice, 22 months old, both sexes; cortex sequentially extracted TBS / TBSX (membrane-enriched) / GnHCl; western blot ABCA1 normalized to Na,K-ATPase, relative to APOE3. Aged mouse whole cortex (all cell types); steady-state membrane fraction that includes intracellular membranes.
human_check: eff estimated from bar means (APOE3 ~1.0, APOE4 ~0.78; reduction). Mice are aged (22 mo). TBSX fraction is total membranes, not plasma membrane specifically.

description: In 18-month-old APOE-TR cortex, total ABCA1 protein was lower and caveolin-1 higher in APOE4-TR than APOE3-TR mice.
quote: At 18 months of age, ABCA1 protein levels were lower and caveolin-1 protein levels were higher in the cortical tissues of APOE4-TR mice than in APOE3-TR mice (Fig. 3J).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less total cortical ABCA1, more caveolin-1) at 18 months
system: APOE3- vs APOE4-TR mice, 18 months, mixed sex; cortical RIPA lysate western blot, ABCA1/beta-tubulin. Aged mouse whole-cortex total protein.
human_check: eff estimated (APOE3 ~2.95 vs APOE4 ~2.45 ABCA1/Tub; reduction).

description: In 8-month-old (non-aged) APOE-TR cortex, caveolin-1 was higher in APOE4-TR mice (about 1.2x, **), but total ABCA1 did not differ from APOE3-TR (no significance mark, means about 3.5 vs 3.3). The bar plot carries no significance mark for ABCA1, and no P is printed.
quote: Higher caveolin-1 protein levels, including the α and β isoforms, were found in APOE4-TR mice than in APOE3-TR mice at 8 months of age (Fig. 3J).
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in total cortical ABCA1 at 8 months; caveolin-1 up)
system: APOE3- vs APOE4-TR mice, 8 months (adult, non-aged), mixed sex; cortical lysate western blot, ABCA1/beta-tubulin and Cav1/beta-actin. Mouse whole cortex.
human_check: Text does not mention ABCA1 at 8 months; the null is read from the unstarred ABCA1/Tub bar plot (APOE3 ~3.5, APOE4 ~3.3).

description: Postmortem human mid-frontal cortex total membrane (TBSX) ABCA1 normalized to Na,K-ATPase was higher in AD than NCI, but did not differ between APOE3/3 and APOE3/4 within either diagnostic group. The stars in the panel compare AD with NCI only; the genotype contrast is not tested, so no P is given.
quote: However, no differences in ABCA1 levels were detected according to APOE genotype (Fig. 2B).
summary: (APOE3/3 -> APOE3/4) -> (no change in membrane-fraction ABCA1 in human brain)
system: Human postmortem mid-frontal cortex (ROS cohort), NCI and AD dementia, APOE3/3 vs APOE3/4; TBSX membrane extract western blot, ABCA1/Na,K-ATPase. Aged postmortem tissue; includes AD cases; heterozygous APOE3/4; total membranes of mixed cell types.
human_check: Group n: NCI E3/3 33, NCI E3/4 19, AD E3/3 44, AD E3/4 42. Plot shows NCI E3/4 mean (~1.6) slightly below NCI E3/3 (~2.0), untested. Stars in panel are AD vs NCI only.

description: HPCD (2 g/kg s.c. twice weekly, 8 to ~10.5 months) in APOE4-TR mice lowered brain oxysterols and membrane caveolin-1 and increased membrane ABCA1 versus PBS, which the authors read as enhanced ABCA1 recycling (rescue in APOE4 only, no APOE3 arm).
quote: Brain tissue fractionation showed a significant decrease in total membrane caveolin-1 levels in HPCD treated-APOE4-TR mice, along with enhanced ABCA1 recycling, as indicated by increased membrane ABCA1 levels (Fig. 5F).
summary: (APOE4 + oxysterol lowering by HPCD) -> (more membrane ABCA1, less caveolin-1)
system: APOE4-TR mice, HPCD vs PBS from 8 months for ~2.5 months (sacrificed ~10.5 months), both sexes; cortex TBSX membrane fraction western blot ABCA1/Na,K-ATPase. Mouse whole cortex; no APOE3 comparator; drug rescue.
human_check: Contrast is HPCD vs PBS within APOE4-TR, not APOE4 vs APOE3. eff estimated (PBS ~0.62, HPCD ~0.78). 'Recycling' is the authors' interpretation of a membrane-level increase; no recycling assay.

description: In the same HPCD experiment, ABCA1 in isolated brain lysosomes and ABCA1 intensity within LAMP1+ areas were lower in HPCD- than PBS-treated APOE4-TR mice, i.e. less lysosomal ABCA1 sequestration after oxysterol lowering.
quote: Lysosomal ABCA1 levels were lower in the HPCD treatment group, as verified by lysosome isolation and immunostaining (Fig. 5G and H
system: APOE4-TR mice, HPCD vs PBS 8 to ~10.5 months; brain lysosome isolation western blot ABCA1/LAMP1 (5G) and confocal ABCA1 in LAMP1+ ROIs (5H, 150 ROI from 5 mice). Mouse brain; no APOE3 comparator; lysosomal compartment; drug rescue.
human_check: eff estimated from 5G (PBS ~1.15, HPCD ~0.75; reduction). Fig 5H gives ****p<0.0001 on 150 ROIs from 5 mice (ROI-level pseudo-replication).

description: In mouse primary astrocytes, caveolin-1 siRNA (but not AP2B1 siRNA) increased biotin-enriched plasma-membrane ABCA1 versus non-target siRNA, supporting caveolae-mediated ABCA1 internalization as the proposed mechanism; no APOE isoform contrast.
quote: Reducing caveolin-1, but not, AP2B1 expression by siRNA increased plasma membrane ABCA1 levels in mouse primary astrocytes (Fig. 3F, Supplementary Fig. 4E)
system: Mouse primary cortical astrocytes from P1-3 APOE-TR pups (genotype used in 3F not stated), siRNA 48 h; surface biotinylation-enriched plasma membrane fraction, ABCA1/Na,K-ATPase western blot. Mouse neonatal astrocytes in vitro.
human_check: Which APOE-TR genotype the 3F astrocytes came from is not stated. eff estimated (NT ~1.07, Cav1 siRNA ~1.75). AP2B1 bar has n=2 visible.

description: In ABCA1-GFP-overexpressing HeLa cells, recombinant ApoE4 (0.2 uM) led to lower total ABCA1 over 24 h than ApoE3 (relative ABCA1 about 0.4 vs 1.0 at 24 h), read by the authors as greater ABCA1 degradation. The plot is densitometry of the single blot shown, with no error bars, and the legend's statistics list covers panels E-H only, so no test was run on 4A.
quote: rE4 treatment resulted in lower total ABCA1 protein levels than rE3 treatment, indicating greater ABCA1 degradation (Supplementary Fig. 4A).
system: HeLa cells stably overexpressing ABCA1-GFP, recombinant ApoE3 vs ApoE4 0.2 uM for a time course; total ABCA1 by anti-GFP western blot. Non-neural cervical carcinoma line; overexpressed tagged ABCA1; exogenous recombinant ApoE.
human_check: Supplementary Fig 4 viewed 2026-11-21 (Europe PMC supplement, MOESM4 TIFF). Effect read off the 24 h points: rE3 about 1.0, rE4 about 0.4 (relative to rE3 at 0 h). Legend: 'densitometric quantification of the blots shown in the upper panel'; tests named for E, F (t-test), G, H only. n left N/A: one lane per time point is implied, not stated as n.
